key_insight: EEG-Xplain provides a unified way to explain black-box EEG foundation models by combining multiple attribution methods across spatial, temporal, and frequency dimensions.
engineering_relevance: It helps make EEG AI systems more trustworthy and clinically usable by standardizing interpretability and reliability checks across different model architectures.
method: Uses gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based attribution methods.
Maps importance over EEG channels, time segments, and spectral bands.
Adds population-level reliability tests with AOPC and cross-method consistency.
evidence_signal: On Mumtaz2016 and TUAB, the explanations matched known neurophysiological markers while also revealing artifact and spurious-pattern dependencies.
watch_item: Explanation quality can still be affected by artifacts and method disagreement, so results should be validated carefully before clinical use.
paper_title: EEG-Xplain: Decoding Neural Black-Boxes of EEG Foundation Models
